propositions: The divergent_implementation axis is mis-calibrated, graded none on ~90% of omitted-scope findings, causing a real defect to score impact 0.0 and land advisory despite blocking being enabled.

Replace the ordinal none|low|medium|high grade for divergent_implementation with a closed Literal set (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none), where the first two keep a 0.85 hard floor and incomplete_enumeration stays below every blocking threshold.
impact_plan must resolve the axis through a new DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 map rather than _SEV01, otherwise the new symbolic grades score 0.0 and the axis stops firing entirely.
Add ADR 0054 mandating data-driven calibration via corpus replay and dogfooding, rejecting high-cost purpose-built LLM eval suites, narrowing ADR 0036's A/B clause.
Bump plan-review IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION to plan-v4 while keeping legacy plan-v3/v2 sidecars readable and migrating all fixtures off the retired ordinal ladder.
The prod_impact floor (Fix 2) is rejected because it lifts an unbounded severity band that collides with the novelty convergence floor and cannot be remediated by editing the plan.
